definitions.full: H933. bohaq בֹּ֫הַק noun masculine a harmless eruption on the skin (Late Hebrew id. , Aramaic בּוֺהֲקָא ; Arabic ) Lev 13:39 . בהר (Late Hebrew Hiph`il be bright, shine ; compare Aramaic בְּהַר , (not Pe`al) & derivatives; Ethiopic Arabic surpass , especially in brightness, shine brightly ).
